messages:
Maria (CEO): quick sticky from today's all-hands  want a short set of clarifications we can push to GTM/docs: 1) short mission line, 2) how to position vs clouds and tiny inference vendors, 3) how public to be about model perf. please keep replies short.
Ajay (CTO): mission shorthand: "make inference predictable and cost-effective for engineers." technical rule: never publish a lone latency number without seq/batch/hw. ops-bot: perf exports at /dashboards/perf-summary.
Lena (Head Product): recommended hero: "Inference engineered for production." split copy: PLG hero (quickstart + examples) and Enterprise hero (SLAs, private deployment).
Tom (Sales): field lens: buyers want SLA first, integration second, cost third. give sales two one-pagers: "SLA & integration" and "quickstart + savings".
Priya (Eng): BYOM checklist items: quant compatibility, max-seq, memory profile, KV cache behavior, recommended test harness. i'll post a draft to #eng.
Sam (Research): competitor map: clouds = scale but opaque pricing; niche vendors = low-cost, limited SLAs; OSS runtimes = flexible but ops-heavy. our angle: opinionated defaults + observability + graceful degradation.
Darci (Strategy): tagline test ideas: A) "Predictable inference, wherever you run it." B) "Inference that behaves in production." will A/B both on the homepage and signup flow.
Marta (Marketing): will prepare marketing-friendly tiers (silver/gold/platinum) that map to verified model performance + link to tech appendix.
Maria (CEO): quick policy Q: publish full perf grids or tiered summaries?
Lena (Head Product): publish detailed grids for "verified" models with test configs; use tiered summaries in marketing. BYOM labeled experimental unless verified.
Tom (Sales): ask: include a one-page compare vs common community checkpoints (latency/cost/notes) for demos.
Ajay (CTO): engineering pledge: we'll maintain a curated verified-model catalog and a BYOM escape hatch. always attach test config to any benchmark.
Priya (Eng): posting BYOM runbook in #eng in ~15m.
Sam (Research): i'll create a short competitor appendix to go with the README.
Darci (Strategy): i'll own quarterly cadence for verified-model reviews and publish a rubric.
Marta (Marketing): queuing tagline A/B test for Monday.
Maria (CEO): thanks everyone  i'll assemble a 1-page README + two sample one-pagers (PLG + enterprise) and post later today. close this thread unless more Qs. :white_check_mark:
